jobs.title: 写实云台宗门
jobs.description: 自然清晨 · 山体尺度与宗门木石
jobs.prompt:
A single 16:9 cinematic environment frame from a very high-budget LIVE-ACTION Chinese xianxia film with photoreal VFX environments. This should look like a real mountain location captured by an ARRI Alexa 65 with physically based CGI extensions. Physically accurate light transport, natural exposure, restrained contrast, subtle atmospheric scattering, photogrammetry-quality geology and building materials. Mature film production design, plausible scale, realistic weight and construction. Cool natural grey rock, subdued vegetation, rough pale limestone, aged timber, real grey clay roof tiles. Let large shapes read clearly, preserve tactile natural materials without oversharpening or excessive microdetail. Wide 32mm lens at human standing height, large negative space in foreground for later live-action actors, strong near/mid/far separation. Foreground ground is dry and matte. No people, no readable text, no collage, no borders, no watermark. Avoid illustration, animation-film look, toy-like architecture, matte-painting brushwork, oversaturated greens, cyan grading, glowing outlines, fantasy-game concept art, excessive mist, bloom, giant sunbeams and perfect decorative symmetry. The image must convincingly hold up as a cinematic photoreal CG environment.
Scene: a quiet high-altitude Taoist cultivation sect built into a real steep granite mountain in the Huangshan range. Foreground is a broad pale-grey stone observation terrace, approximately 8 metres wide, with irregular but carefully fitted slabs, a simple low worn stone edge and one modest stone balustrade along the right side. The stone is structurally real and slightly age-stained rather than dirty. At upper left, a small branch of a real twisted Chinese pine frames the view. The viewer stands on the terrace, looking across a deep valley. On a midground ridge about 150 metres away there is one elegant small complex of weathered timber halls with traditional dark-grey tiled roofs and off-white lime-plastered walls, quietly integrated into the ridge. Most of the image is natural mountains, not palaces. Immense real granite slopes rise above a low cloud inversion; the valleys disappear naturally into it. Distant blue-grey ridges softly recede. A narrow real waterfall is only a small detail down one shaded cliff. Early morning after sunrise with diffused warm-white light, thin high cloud, natural restrained colours. The cultivation-world atmosphere comes from altitude, solitude, monumental terrain and ancient architecture. Make the scene feel photographed at a real mountain monastery, with subtle seamless CG extension of the distant mountains. No floating islands. No cranes. No pink flower trees. No magic emblems on the floor. No gilded railings. Highly believable cinematic realism.
jobs.visual_review_notes: 山体与宗门比例克制，清晨散射光，石材木构具有实景感。

Scene: the entrance road of an ancient mountain cultivation sect at an elevation above the clouds. The camera stands on a broad, dry grey-stone platform approached by a practical 4-metre-wide mountain carriage road. The road winds gently beside a deep natural gorge toward a restrained but grand Ming/Song-inspired mountain gate built from massive dark timber columns, grey stone plinths and matte charcoal roof tiles. One gate and one short side colonnade only. Building joints, tile thickness, stone foundations and load-bearing elements are plausible at human scale. A few gnarled pines emerge from the rock. Behind the gate, tall natural dark granite ridges disappear into low valley clouds, barely suggesting a larger hidden sect beyond. Soft overcast morning light gives rich, realistic wood, stone and muted olive-green trees. Composition reads like a film set extended with seamless VFX mountain backgrounds. The foreground has clear empty ground where a horse cart and several people could later stand. The world feels inhabited and ancient, with practical access and believable architecture. No giant stairways blocking the carriage road. No rows of identical pavilions. No shiny marble. No gold trim. No magic rays or glowing runes.
jobs.visual_review_notes: 近景山门结构与瓦片厚度清楚，车道留有通行空间。

Scene: an isolated cultivation courtyard constructed on a real rocky cliff ledge. The foreground is a spacious rectangular dry-stone practice yard with large subtly uneven limestone slabs. To the left, a single modest timber hall with charcoal-grey tiled roof and deeply shadowed carved wooden doors anchors the space, with credible stone piers supporting a short timber gallery following the cliff. To the right, one huge old pine grows naturally from a fissure in the cliff edge. Beyond the yard, a vast vertical valley opens between enormous realistic layered granite and limestone walls, sparse pine forests and a thin cloud inversion far below. There is a distant small meditation pavilion on a separate ridge, reached by a practical narrow stone path, almost lost to atmospheric perspective. Late-afternoon light falls at an angle from outside the frame, giving long soft shadows on the yard and revealing tangible stone texture and the varied wood grain of a few beams. The colour palette is restrained warm-neutral rock, deep natural greens, faded wood and grey-blue distance. Visually calm and immense, like a photoreal AAA cinematic shot with grounded historical Chinese architecture. Use subtle age and material variation, no clutter and no debris. No fantasy floating rocks, no glossy surfaces, no ornamental palace sprawl.
jobs.visual_review_notes: 古松、木廊和悬崖形成前中远层次，午后侧光自然。

Scene: a moonlit mountain cultivation sect above a cloud inversion, rendered as a convincing live-action night exterior with photoreal VFX. The foreground is an empty dry-grey limestone observation platform next to one old timber colonnade, with room for actors, no wet reflections. A few warm lanterns hang naturally from the beams and illuminate only a small radius. Midground: sparse dark-grey roofed halls follow the ridgeline below, their few paper windows glowing dim amber. Beyond: real rugged mountain ridges under a full moon of normal realistic angular size, high thin clouds partly veil the moon. Moonlight produces subdued cool-silver edges and nuanced deep shadows, with a very slight milky valley cloud layer catching light below. The sky is a natural dark desaturated blue with only a few faint stars. This is a subtle inhabited mountain world rather than a magical space vista. Use believable film night exposure so the courtyard and structure remain readable without turning the whole sky bright. No gigantic moon, no bright Milky Way ribbon, no neon, no glowing architecture, no light trails. The grandeur should come from the landscape scale and distance.
jobs.visual_review_notes: 正常月亮尺度、银灰夜色与局部暖灯，石坪保持可见。
